name: Misleading Signpost
oracle_text:
Flash
When this artifact enters during the declare attackers step, you may reselect which player or permanent target attacking creature is attacking. (It can't attack its controller or their permanents.)
{T}: Add {U}.
blocked_sentences: When this artifact enters during the declare attackers step, you may reselect which player or permanent target attacking creature is attacking. (It can't attack its controller or their permanents.)

needs.what: an op that changes which player, planeswalker or battle a target attacking creature is attacking, with the new defender chosen by the effect's controller from among the attacking creature's legal defenders, excluding the attacking creature's controller and permanents that player controls
needs.why_existing_wont_do: cant_attack_player and must_attack_planeswalker only constrain attack declarations that have not happened yet; put_onto_battlefield/create_token `attacking` only set the defender for an object entering the battlefield attacking. No op changes the defender of a creature that is already attacking
